source: Existing 32 completed procedural_v2 Classic Generic 11x9 two-player maps seed6316000, sampled every fourth round; post hoc read-only diagnostic, not a fresh independent validation

definitions.root_static_gap: Selected candidate position_score immediately after the root turn minus static rank-zero position_score; zero or negative by construction
definitions.reply_gap: Selected candidate native position_score after the searched opponent full turn minus rank-zero score after its searched opponent full turn
definitions.response_swing: reply_gap minus root_static_gap; a differential effect of the searched response, not a complete-game outcome

validation: The refactored frozen-model loader reproduced the prior opponent-plan audit byte-for-byte (SHA256 e1c0c18502203fbb0e40a1920ccf80edfb396f99e80ae9cbd599938587503b70); new decomposition unit tests passed.
interpretation: On this already-inspected 32-map sample, the teacher almost always chose a non-static root turn when the selected candidate induced a different serialized opponent action sequence. The frozen student frequently overrode static rank zero with the same opponent sequence and no median response advantage, while its changed-sequence overrides had a positive median response swing that often failed to overcome the initial static deficit. This motivates a separate response-swing or change/no-change target, but is not proof that such a model will transfer. Identical action sequences may have different effects in different board states.
decision: No policy change, retraining, threshold tuning, rating, or deployment. Design any response-outcome student with predeclared disjoint fit/validation and fresh complete-game both-seat map gates; preserve final seed6300000 and rejected selective seed6315000 untouched.
